name: psysfpload
transitions: real->protected with CS/DS/SS/ES all based at linear 0x00080000
paging enable (CR3=0x00001000, CR0.PG 0->1; PT[128] maps linear 0x00080000 to physical 0x00090000)
paged common-base 32-bit DS:[ESI] MOV r32,[base] load
description: Generic protected-mode common-base fast-load regression. The BIOS bootstrap copies a 32-bit client to physical 0x80000 for pre-paging execution and physical 0x90000 for paged execution, maps the client's non-zero linear 0x80000 page through a 4 KiB PD/PT hierarchy to that different physical page, and plants a distinct data sentinel in the latter. It enters four 4 GiB CS/DS/SS/ES segments with the shared non-zero 0x80000 base, enables paging, then repeatedly loads that client-relative sentinel using the exact no-displacement DS:[ESI] MOV r32,[base] form admitted by VEN_SYS_FASTLOAD_FLAT. The running sum is differentially checked against QEMU, so a segment-base or non-identity D-TLB/page-walk bypass diverges; no Quake-specific state or saved guest state is used.
